acceptance: The BenchBox v0.1.7 re-lock PR adds a decision record under _project/decisions covering D1, D2, D3 and D6, with D2 recorded explicitly as narrowing the BenchBox gate's promotion scope.
context: Decisions were made in session 2026-11-05 through the choice dialog ('Depth first', 'Executed surface', '~/Developer/benchmark_runs', 'Accept all').
description:
Owner decisions 2026-11-05 on the brief-size remediation plan (local://brief-size-remediation-plan.md §7):
- D1: depth first. Theseus v0.1.7 ships the review-depth fixes before the 0.2.0 rename, with a fallback to relaxing 0.2.0 if v0.1.7 isn't promoted within 5 working days.
- D2: promotion required reads limited to the executed surface (package source, pyproject.toml, review.yml, gate.yml), plus rename detection.
- D3: coverage required for SHIP and SHIP WITH FIXES; a SHIP from before the change is re-reviewed on its next head.
- D4: compaction off and treated as failure.
- D5: diff always built from git.
- D6: BenchBox configuration trimmed to the minimum.
- D7: archive in ~/Developer/benchmark_runs.
- D8: greps earn no coverage.
- D9: if the offline audit of the v0.1.7 promotion fails, it qualifies for a repair-class relaxation.
D1, D2, D3 and D6 go into the decision record of the BenchBox v0.1.7 re-lock PR.
